item: Row 141: liveness probe caps the loopback connect at 0.5 s
summary: On Windows a refused loopback connect takes ~2 s; is_running waited it out, so every pull with no daemon paid it. Connect now capped at 0.5 s, reply keeps the whole timeout (a slow daemon still reads running); no state kept. Modelled: is_running 2.12 -> 0.51 s.
